vetSays.line: ★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Mateo taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Kate showed Wilhelm the Ground Elder — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
Nikolai showed Leo the Ground Elder — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
🛡️ Soo, Wilhelm, Giuseppe and Kate met them at the door — 4 put down. Soo, Wilhelm, Giuseppe, Kate are hurt.
Mateo is showing everyone Ground Elder by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
🛡️ Soo, Chantelle, Kate, Nikolai and Leo met them at the door — 5 put down. Soo, Chantelle, Kate, Nikolai, Leo are hurt.
🌿 Ground Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
🛡️ Xavier and Nikolai met them at the door — 2 put down. Xavier, Nikolai are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Giuseppe just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nikolai just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Wilhelm, Giuseppe, Xavier and Nikolai met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Giuseppe, Xavier, Nikolai are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Leo just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mateo just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
Mateo: "Ground Elder is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
🌿 Ground Elder, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ines just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ines met them at the door — 1 put down. Ines is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Emma just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Emma met them at the door — 1 put down. Emma is hurt.
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Emma just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nikolai just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
